name: api_raw_suite
description: Gate 2: Raw validation of the API source (MinJusticia - Comisarías de Familia, SODA REST API), evaluated on the normalized raw JSON payload BEFORE any business transformation.

meta.data_object: Raw SODA payload data/raw/api_comisarias_raw.json normalized to a tabular frame (text values, missing keys kept as null)
meta.source: Ministerio de Justicia y del Derecho / datos.gov.co (resource 7tuu-upb2)

derived_evaluation_columns.existencia_numeric: pd.to_numeric(existencia_de_comisarias, errors='coerce'). Type cast used ONLY for evaluation; the raw payload is not modified.

meta.threshold_justification: Contractual: these 4 attributes are the integration key and the only API inputs to R6 (installed comisarías) and R7 (Ley 2126 requirement, category). Without any of them R6/R7 cannot be computed, so zero tolerance.

meta.metric: Length between 4 and 5 characters for 100% of rows
meta.threshold_justification: Integration contract: the documented normalization is zfill(5), which is only correct for 4-digit codes that lost their leading zero (profiling: 194 rows) and 5-digit codes. Any other length would produce a wrong municipal key and a silent mis-join, so no tolerance.

meta.metric: Values outside the Ley 617 set {1-6, ESP} <= 2% (nulls evaluated separately and imputed as 'NO REPORTADA')
meta.threshold_justification: Legal domain (Ley 617 de 2000). Category is only a drill-down attribute of R7; it does not change any measure. Up to 2% (about 25 of ~1,250 entries) unexpected labels can be shown as an 'other' bucket without altering the R7 priority ranking, so the batch continues with a recorded warning.

meta.metric: Installed comisarías >= 0 for 100% of non-null values
meta.threshold_justification: Business rule: a count of facilities cannot be negative. A negative value would inflate the Ley 2126 gap (R7) and produce a negative or infinite workload ratio (R6).

Each API row is one listed comisaría, so a null count is imputed as 1 (the row itself). This assumption is acceptable while it affects a small minority of rows; above 10% the R6 denominator would be driven by the imputation rather than by the source, so the condition must be made visible. Observed baseline: 8.5% (106 of 1,249).
